fullContentHtml:
RRB ALP CEN 01/2026 Online Application Status 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released Application Status for the recruitment of Assistant Loco Pilot (ALP) on the official website of the RRBs. This recruitment has been issued for 11,127 posts. The online registration process for Railway RRB Group D Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 15 May 2026, to 14 June 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their RRB ALP CEN 01/2026 Online Application Status 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 15 May 2026
  • Last Date : 14 June 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 16 June 2026
  • Correction / Modified Form : 17-26 June 2026
  • Application Status : 22 August 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 500/–
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 250/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 250/-
  • Fee Refund (After Appearing in Stage I Exam) :
  • General, OBC, EWS : Rs. 400/–
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
